title: Recommendation
description: CONTRACTS §4.3 — an action tied to a Finding. reason_type ∈ {evidence, heuristic, business_context_required}; `evidence` REQUIRES non-empty evidence_refs (recommendations must cite existing evidence, never invent causes). AI/LLM output (Phase 4) uses the same shape.

action.description: Imperative verb-phrase stating the suggested next step.

rationale.description: Why — must be grounded in evidence_refs (CONTRACTS §7).

target_improvement.description: Observable state after the action lands (e.g. 'missing rate back under 5%').

do_not.description: Anti-patterns to avoid (e.g. 'Do not fill empty values with zero as a first response.').

status.description: MVP emits `proposed`; downstream transitions are Final App workflow territory.
